scene: Compact readable chronicle vignette: a wax-sealed royal supply licence resting on a wood table beside a closed ledger, small wool bale and purse, town official hand steadying it. No visible writing, parchment turned blank-side up, red wax seal without letters.
prompt:
Create ONE complete illustration for a historical city-building game, one continuous scene, NOT a contact sheet, no collage, no inset panels. Reference 1 sets the muted hand-painted naturalistic storybook landscape style; reference 2 contains multiple examples ONLY for brushwork and materials (do not copy its multi-panel layout); reference 3 sets grounded painted human face style. Southern England in 1318–1347, ordinary timber/plaster/thatch medieval buildings with NO household chimneys, muted ochres, dusty reds and grey greens, subtle painted texture, soft natural light, modest human scale, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, interface, border or watermark. No horror, no gore. Chronicle illustration: square format, slightly simplified illuminated-manuscript storytelling but SAME muted painterly realism, no ornamental frame. Compact readable chronicle vignette: a wax-sealed royal supply licence resting on a wood table beside a closed ledger, small wool bale and purse, town official hand steadying it. No visible writing, parchment turned blank-side up, red wax seal without letters. Output 384 by 384 pixels.
ROOF CORRECTION: TARGETED LOCAL EDIT of this exact illustration. Preserve all composition, people, faces, poses, buildings, objects, lighting and brushwork. ONLY REMOVE EVERY domestic rooftop chimney, chimney pot, masonry stack or flue, including small distant ones. Specific offending positions in original 384x384 image include gray stack on near red roof x144,y56 and thatch x195,y64. Each stack is only about 7–15 pixels wide but must be removed. Reconstruct continuous roof tile/thatch/ridge and correct background behind removed stacks. No physical chimney shafts anywhere on houses. Do not just remove smoke. Preserve church towers, wall towers, market cross, flagstaffs and ordinary gable peaks. No added objects, no changes to heraldry. Same exact image and aspect ratio.
postprocess: Lanczos3 resize and central cover crop to target; opaque illustration PNG
